title: MAGIC-SSCIL: Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration for Semi-Supervised Class Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.07586v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Exemplar-free semi-supervised class-incremental learning (SSCIL) asks a model to learn new classes from a few labeled and many unlabeled images without storing past data. A common recipe replays old classes from stored Gaussian statistics and pseudo-labels unlabeled data with a confidence threshold. With one or two labels per class, however, the model's confidence is a poor guide to which pseudo-labels are right, so the statistics that replay depends on rest on few or noisy samples. We propose MAGIC (Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration), which propagates labels over a k-nearest-neighbor graph of frozen features and uses the propagated confidences as weights in the unlabeled loss and, through Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC), in the class statistics from which phantom features replay old classes. With a frozen ResNet-18 on CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R at 1%, 5%, and 10% labels, we compare MAGI

translated_title: MAGIC-SSCIL：面向半监督类增量学习的流形锚定与几何增量校准
translated_abstract: 无样本回放的半监督类增量学习要求模型在仅有少量有标签图像和大量无标签图像的情况下学习新类别，同时不存储历史数据。一种常见做法是从存储的高斯统计量中回放旧类，并用置信度阈值对无标签数据进行伪标签标注。然而，当每个类别只有一两个标签时，模型的置信度难以可靠地判断哪些伪标签是正确的，因此回放所依赖的统计量往往建立在极少或含噪声的样本之上。我们提出了MAGIC（流形锚定与几何增量校准），该方法在冻结特征的k近邻图上进行标签传播，并将传播后的置信度作为无标签损失的权重；同时通过软加权几何校准，将这些置信度融入旧类幻影特征回放所依据的类别统计量中。在CIFAR-100、CUB-200和ImageNet-R数据集上使用冻结的ResNet-18，并在1%、5%和10%的标签比例下，我们比较了MAGI……
tldr: MAGIC通过在冻结特征的k近邻图上进行标签传播，并将传播置信度同时用于无标签损失加权和软加权几何校准的类别统计量构建，解决了极端少标签场景下半监督类增量学习中伪标签不可靠、回放统计量稀疏噪声的问题。
en_tdlr: MAGIC addresses unreliable pseudo-labels and sparse, noisy replay statistics in semi-supervised class-incremental learning under extremely scarce labels by propagating labels over a k-nearest-neighbor graph of frozen features and using the propagated confidences to weight both the unlabeled loss and the class statistics via Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration.
